newsitem.title: USA: California Amplifier sees Q3 profit.
newsitem.headline: California Amplifier sees Q3 profit.

text.p: California Amplifier Inc said Wednesday that it sees a return to profitability in the third quarter.
"We currently anticipate returning to profitability," said Ira Coron, Chief Executive Officer of California Amplifier referring to the firm's prospects for the third quarter.
California Amplifier posted a loss for the second quarter of $209,000 or $0.02 a share compared with a profit of $1.07 million or $0.09 a share in the year-ago period.
The company attributed its loss for the second quarter to lower than expected sales accompanied with higher operating costs and expenditures on developing new digital products.

Sales of Wireless Cable reception products were well below recent quarterly sales levels due to reduced shipments to international markets, primarily Asia, delays in the roll out of new wireless systems in other international markets and continued softness in the domestic market.
The company also said sales of MultiCipher related products were less than expected.
